title: Units and composition of finite coefficient extension
statement: Let l be prime. Coefficient fields are finite extensions of Q_l with specified Q_l-algebra embeddings. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaves and raw rationalizations of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Schemes supporting a constructible rational category are assumed noetherian, finite-dimensional, with l invertible; ambient operation comparisons are for arbitrary scheme morphisms g : X → Y in the actual ambient derived categories. For finite coefficient-field embeddings E → F → G, their completed coefficient maps compose as the completed map of the composite embedding. Derived tensor balancing induces the ambient composition isomorphism and the natural rational composition isomorphism. For the identity field embedding the completed coefficient map is the identity and the derived and rational tensor functors have their canonical unit isomorphisms.

source.place: Order 1307; existing scalar-extension component, relocated without changing signatures or proofs.

proof.text: Apply every residue projection to the composite completed coefficient map. Quotient inclusions compose, so joint monicity of the limit projections identifies this map with that of the composite embedding. For an identity embedding the same argument gives the identity map.

The normalized scalar adjunctions identify their successive left adjoints with the direct left adjoint. Their Hom equivalences give the displayed naturality equation, hence the ambient balanced tensor isomorphism. Apply raw rationalization to its components. Tensor induction proves its naturality for all rational arrows.

The restriction functor for the identity coefficient map is canonically the identity. Adjunction uniqueness gives the ambient tensor unit. Apply rationalization to its components and use tensor induction for rational naturality.
